name: Devin CLI
desc: Terminal coding agent that hands a session to the cloud.
desc_zh: 在终端里运行的编程智能体，任务变大时可移交给云端。
solves: Local agents stall when a job needs its own machine; the same session continues on a cloud computer and comes back as a pull request.
solves_zh: 本地智能体一遇到需要独立环境的任务就卡住；同一个会话能转到云端继续跑，回来就是 Pull Request。
best_for: You start a fix in the terminal and want it to keep running after you close the laptop.
best_for_zh: 在终端里开了个修复任务，合上电脑也想让它继续跑完。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — cognition.com/blog directory）。 cli.devin.ai redirects to the docs page. Separate surface from the Devin web app already in the ledger; the announcement is two days ahead of the docs changelog entry. 首次公开日期来源：https://cognition.com/blog/devin-for-terminal
